caption: The drawing depicts a metallic candlestick with a bulbous, ornate column and a hexagonal base. The main depiction is colored in shades of gold and brass, showing light reflections and shadows that give it a three-dimensional appearance. To the upper left of the candlestick, there is a black line drawing of the object from the front view, showing its profile. Below this, there is a hexagonal overhead view, also drawn in black lines, with concentric lines indicating the structure of the base. Directly below the overhead view, there is a linear scale in inches, marked from 0 to 3 inches, with both major and minor divisions. The drawings and the colored depiction are placed inside a neat rectangular border on a plain, light beige background. The name “Philip Johnson” is printed in small letters in the lower right corner outside the border.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
